title: Find a user's email
prompt: find_email(users, name) looks up a user's email in a list of records and returns None if the user is not there. It only ever finds the first user.
hints: Trace the call for 'Bo'. What happens on the very first pass of the loop?
'return' ends the whole function immediately, not just the current pass of the loop.
You can only say 'not found' after checking every user, so move 'return None' after the loop.
explanation: The else branch returned None on the first non-matching user, ending the search early. 'Not found' is only known after the loop finishes.
